cell_type.evidence: inferred: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) were isolated from freshly drawn, EDTA anticoagulated blood by separation over a Ficoll-Paque TM PLUS gradient (GE Healthcare).
inferred: Red blood cells (RBCs) were isolated from freshly drawn, citrate anticoagulated blood by centrifugation at 105 g for 5 minutes (Eppendorf 5417R Refrigerated Centrifuge).

inferred: FVIII-AnxA5 and FVIII-AnxA5-RBCs-loaded monocyte derived macrophages were harvested and resuspended in 500 μL of lysis buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 0.25% octyl-β-D-glucopyranoside, 1% sodium deoxycholate and 10 mM EDTA) for 30 min at 4°C.
